DATE:
June 24, 1972

DATE
Please review the attached environmental impact statement and indicate your comment with respect to any environmental impact involved.
Comments: (Please check one block.)
No comment (Environmental impact statement is in order and no additional comments are offered.)
Comment. (Elaborate below.)
Commant ere:
Executive Order 11644 has been reviewed by personnel of the Game and Fish Division. We agree that off-road vehicles should be controlled on public lands. Inasmuch as National Wildlife Refuges and Wildlife Management Areas were established for the protection, perpetuation and management of wildlife resources, it is strongly recommended that the Bureau of Sport Fisheries and Wildlife prohibit areas and trails for off-road vehicles within the boundaries of such facilities.
